Pet Filter — UX Heuristic Audit

A walk-through of the volume, plate by plate.

EVALUATED · 2026-05-27 METHOD · NIELSEN 10 HEURISTICS + TASK FLOW SCOPE · 5 PHASES, FRONTISPIECE → WALL

The Task Flow

The golden path is short — five phases, one ~60-second wait. The wall is a side branch.

Frontispiece
land + intrigue
→
Picker
pick species + likeness
→
Processing
~60 sec wait
→
Result
reveal + save
↘
Wall
side branch — view all

The Five Plates

I · Frontispiece
cover / landing
  • Rotating Audubon plate as the centerpiece
  • Wax seal = single colour accent
  • Tap target: central plate OR footer 『开卷』
II · Picker
specimen + species
  • Drop-cap hero + italic deck
  • Specimen slot (avatar or upload)
  • 12 plates in 3 categories
III · Processing
~60-second wait
  • Cycling stage labels in italic display
  • Scan-line animation over photo
  • No % progress, no cancel
IV · Result
reveal + caption
  • Plate inside double-frame square
  • Species name + Latin caption
  • No share / no save button
V · Wall
community archive
  • My / All scope tabs (state lifted)
  • List + Grid toggles
  • Empty state needs more pull

Heuristic Findings

major — important to fix minor — worth fixing soon cosmetic — polish
Severity Heuristic Phase Issue · Description · Recommendation
MAJOR H1
Visibility of system status		 Processing No progress %, no elapsed time, no cancel
60s wait shows only a cycling text label and a moving scan-line. Users will fear the page is frozen and may refresh, killing the gen and losing the upload.
→ Add a progress bar (could be quill-ink filling a vial), and a small ESC link 『取消雕版』 that aborts and returns to picker.
MAJOR H1
Visibility of system status		 Frontispiece Central plate looks decorative, not tappable
The pulsing italic 『— 开卷 —』 sits under the species caption, easily missed. The big circle has no button affordance.
→ Add a clearer tap hint: small pointing-finger icon in the corner, or a visible underline-button below the caption. Or expand the tap target boundary visually.
MAJOR H7
Flexibility and efficiency		 Result No SHARE button on the most shareable artifact
After 60s of generation, the user lands on a beautiful plate — but cannot send it to a friend in one tap. This is the core viral hook of the game.
→ Add a 『分享』 link near the wax-seal area, opening Aigram post-share. Mirror the Mugshot / Album-Cover pattern.
MINOR H3
User control and freedom		 Picker No way back to frontispiece
Footer-left action goes to 学会档案 (wall), not back to the cover. User who opened by mistake can't return without refreshing.
→ Add an optional 『回到扉页』 chevron in the head area, OR make the breadcrumb plate label clickable.
MINOR H6
Recognition over recall		 Wall List/Grid toggle is small and easy to miss
The two icons in the top right are sub-20px and have low contrast.
→ Increase to 24px and add a subtle background pill to the active state.
MINOR H1
Visibility of system status		 Picker Disabled CTA reason is implicit
When no specimen or species is picked, footer hero reads 『待收标本』 in muted italic. New users may not realize they need to tap a species + upload a photo.
→ Show a tiny inline hint below the disabled CTA: 『先选一种生物』 or 『先提交肖像』 — whichever is missing.
MINOR H2
Match real world		 Frontispiece 『an example』 label is too quiet on demo state
Cycling plates may be misread as the user's own work or community work. Italic small caption gets lost under the dominant species name.
→ Promote 『示例标本』 to a small banner across the plate (e.g. 『SPECIMEN — example only』 across the top of the oval, like a watermark stamp).
MINOR H5
Error prevention		 Picker Specimen slot has only camera icon
Empty upload slot reads as ambiguous — could be a photo placeholder, a tap target, or just decorative. New users may not know it's clickable.
→ Replace the SVG with a clearer prompt: 『tap to upload』 inside the box, or a dashed border + plus icon. Or auto-fill with the user's Aigram avatar (already implemented; just ensure it's the dominant cue when present).
MINOR H6
Recognition over recall		 Result 『学会判定此对象属于』 + title duplicates info
The 『The Society has determined this subject to be a』 caption + 『CAPYBARA』 title repeat the same idea twice. The Society line is small and lost.
→ Drop the duplicate caption OR fold it into a single sentence: 『学会判定您为 CAPYBARA · Hydrochoerus hydrochaeris』 in one styled line.
MINOR H4
Consistency and standards		 Wall Empty state lacks an inviting CTA
『还没有人收录，等你来做第一页』 is good copy but has no actionable visual element near it.
→ Add a small ghosted plate beneath the empty text with a 『tap to begin』 hint, mirroring the frontispiece affordance.
COSMETIC H8
Aesthetic and minimalist design		 Frontispiece Three CTAs on landing (plate / footer-hero / footer-left)
Central plate, 『开卷 →』 button and 『档案室』 link — user has three choices on first view, which can dilute the primary path.
→ Visually demote 『档案室』 (smaller, fainter) so 『开卷』 is unambiguously the primary path.
COSMETIC H8
Aesthetic and minimalist design		 Processing Empty selfie preview slot when source is URL
In demo, the slot appears empty. In production with a real avatar it'll fill, but the placeholder corners + the cream background read as 『nothing here』.
→ Always render the source thumbnail (or a slightly stylized fallback) so the slot never appears empty during the 60s wait.
COSMETIC H4
Consistency and standards		 Picker Section labels italic + small caps look like ribbons
『家常之属』 / 『温良之属』 / 『诡异之属』 are typographically beautiful but the categorization itself isn't obvious — what makes a clam 『uncanny』?
→ Optional: add a tiny info icon next to each section label with a one-liner explaining the category, OR drop the categories entirely and use 4×3 grid.
COSMETIC H2
Match real world		 Processing 『雕版师未能完成』 error copy out of band
If gen fails, user is silently bounced back to picker with the error line. The naturalist voice is consistent but the user may not realize what to do.
→ Persist the error line at the top of the picker with a 『再试一次』 inline button.

Recommended Order of Work

If we ship one batch at a time, this is the sequence I'd take.

BATCH 1 · 30 MIN

Make waiting bearable

Add progress bar (quill-ink filling a vial), elapsed seconds, and a small 『取消雕版』 link. Always render the source thumbnail behind the scan-line. Persist gen errors at the top of picker.

BATCH 2 · 20 MIN

Reveal the cover affordance

Strengthen the central plate as the primary CTA: add a finger / underline button hint, demote 『档案室』 footer link, make 『示例标本』 watermark visible across the demo plate.

BATCH 3 · 25 MIN

Close the loop on Result

Add 『分享』 button (Aigram post-share), fold the duplicate 『学会判定您为…』 caption into the title block. Optionally surface 『save image』 for off-platform.

BATCH 4 · 20 MIN

Picker discoverability

Specimen slot gets a clearer 『tap to upload』 prompt. Disabled CTA explains what's missing (『先选一种生物』 / 『先提交肖像』). Optional: subtle 『回到扉页』 breadcrumb.

BATCH 5 · 15 MIN

Wall pull

Empty-state gets a tappable ghosted plate / CTA. List/Grid toggle bumps to 24px with active pill. Section category tooltips (optional).

BATCH 6 · BACKLOG

Atmosphere polish

Page-turn sounds. Subtle parchment crinkle on phase change. Long-press image to save. Tutorial blip on first-ever open.
